correctness.rationale: For the specified F_2 Clebsch cubic, a nondegenerate Hermitian equation implies smoothness and all 27 geometric lines are F_4-rational. The 15 F_2 points and Lefschetz trace give invariant Picard rank six. Six explicit F_2-lines have exact Gram determinant -2 (independently recomputed by the included verifier), so their full-rank sublattice is integrally saturated: index squared divides 2. The finite-field Brauer group vanishes, identifying invariants with arithmetic Picard. Smooth cubic Picard unimodularity gives the Frobenius root-reflection corollary. No finite enumeration is claimed as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Arithmetic Picard groups classify rational divisor classes integrally. The six chosen actual F_2-line classes supply a minimal explicit integer basis and a squarefree determinant saturation certificate, which are stronger than the existing point/line counts and Frobenius conjugacy class and directly support effective divisors, intersection calculations and descent on this natural highly symmetric cubic. No general classification is claimed.
